These elements form a dynamic system where F triggers S when G exceeds a critical threshold. The failure mode occurs when S becomes too strong, causing irreversible memory loss or chronic symptomatology. Dualities arise in that repression can be seen both as a protective mechanism and a pathological outcome depending on context. The epistemic closure of these systems requires recursive feedback between emotional processing and cognitive recall.
